title: Using VBIM Technique to Discover ARMC4/ODAD2 as a Novel Negative Regulator of NF-kappaB and a New Tumor Suppressor in Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Martin, Matthew; Mundade, Rasika; Hartley, Antja-Voy; Jiang, Guanglong; Jin, Jiamin; Sun, Steven; Safa, Ahmad; Sandusky, George; Liu, Yunlong; Lu, Tao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过VBIM技术发现ARMC4作为NF-kappaB负调控因子和结直肠癌抑癌基因，虽涉及蛋白互作但非DNA结合，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Since nuclear factor (NF) kappaB plays pivotal roles in inflammation and cancer, understanding its regulation holds great promise for disease therapy. Using the powerful validation-based insertional mutagenesis (VBIM) technique established by us previously, we discovered armadillo repeat-containing protein 4 (ARMC4)/outer dynein arm docking complex subunit 2 (ODAD2), a rarely studied protein known to date, as a novel negative regulator of NF-kappaB in colorectal cancer (CRC). High expression of ARMC4 downregulated the expression of NF-kappaB-dependent genes, dramatically reduced NF-kappaB activity, cellular proliferation, anchorage-independent growth, and migratory ability in vitro, and significantly decreased xenograft tumor growth in vivo. Co-immunoprecipitation experiments demonstrated that ARMC4 forms a complex with NF-kappaB. Importantly, the lower ARMC4 expression in patient tumors than normal tissues indicates its potential tumor suppressor function in CRC. Collectively, we uncovered a completely new facet of ARMC4 function by identifying it as a novel NF-kappaB negative regulator, thus uncovering ARMC4 as a potential new therapeutic target in CRC.
abstract_zh: 由于核因子（NF）kappaB在炎症和癌症中扮演关键角色，理解其调控机制对疾病治疗具有重大前景。利用我们先前建立的高效验证型插入突变（VBIM）技术，我们发现了含有犰狳重复序列的蛋白4（ARMC4）/外动力蛋白臂对接复合物亚基2（ODAD2），这是一种迄今研究较少的蛋白，作为结直肠癌（CRC）中NF-kappaB的新型负调控因子。ARMC4的高表达下调了NF-kappaB依赖性基因的表达，显著降低了NF-kappaB活性、细胞增殖、锚定非依赖性生长及体外迁移能力，并在体内显著减少了异种移植肿瘤的生长。免疫共沉淀实验表明，ARMC4与NF-kappaB形成复合物。重要的是，患者肿瘤中ARMC4的表达低于正常组织，提示其在CRC中可能具有肿瘤抑制功能。总之，我们通过将ARMC4鉴定为一种新型NF-kappaB负调控因子，揭示了其功能的崭新方面，从而将ARMC4定位为CRC中潜在的新治疗靶点。
